isolation: no container to own: unique timestamped note text, and count-before/after assertions for refusal scenarios. One login (test-team-member) stands in for Maya, Ravi and Dan, so cross-author display is not separable.

scenarios.rule: A team member can post a plain-text note and it appears at once

steps.text: Maya the team member is signed in and sees the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/; fill username/password, click Sign In (test-team-member, the only published login); wait lands on /board

steps.text: Maya posts the note "Retro moves to Thursday 3pm"
steps.command: agent-browser fill @e39 <note>; agent-browser click @e17 (UI; text suffixed with a timestamp for uniqueness)

steps.text: "Retro moves to Thursday 3pm" is the first note on the board
steps.command: agent-browser wait --text "Retro moves to Thursday 3pm 1792180776" --timeout 4000
steps.observed: snapshot showed it as the first row cell, ahead of older notes

scenarios.rule: A team member can post a plain-text note and it appears at once
scenarios.scenario: A note of exactly 280 characters is accepted

steps.text: Maya the team member is signed in and sees the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/; fill username/password, click Sign In (test-team-member, the only published login); wait lands on /board

steps.text: Maya posts a note of exactly 280 characters
steps.command: agent-browser fill @e39 <280-char string>; agent-browser click @e17
steps.observed: POST /api/notes 201; string length verified 280 with shell

steps.text: that note is on the board
steps.command: agent-browser wait --text <the 280-char string> --timeout 4000

scenarios.rule: A note may not be empty or longer than 280 characters
scenarios.scenario: A note of 281 characters is refused

steps.text: Maya the team member is signed in and sees the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/; fill username/password, click Sign In (test-team-member, the only published login); wait lands on /board

steps.text: Maya notes how many notes the board has
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody tr"

steps.text: Maya posts a note of 281 characters
steps.command: agent-browser fill @e39 <281-char string>; agent-browser click @e17 (button enabled, clicked via UI)
steps.observed: page showed 'A note cannot be longer than 280 characters.'; no new POST /api/notes appeared in network requests

steps.text: the board has the same number of notes as before
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody tr"

scenarios.rule: A note may not be empty or longer than 280 characters
scenarios.scenario: A note of only spaces is refused

steps.text: Maya the team member is signed in and sees the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/; fill username/password, click Sign In (test-team-member, the only published login); wait lands on /board

steps.text: Maya notes how many notes the board has
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody tr"

steps.text: Maya posts a note containing only spaces
steps.command: agent-browser fill @e39 "     "; agent-browser click @e17
steps.observed: page showed 'A note cannot be empty.'; no new POST /api/notes (count of POSTs in buffer unchanged at 2)

steps.text: the board has the same number of notes as before
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody tr"

scenarios.rule: Everyone on the team sees every note, newest first, with author and time
scenarios.scenario: A teammate sees another member's note

steps.text: Maya has posted the note "Staging is back up"
steps.command: posted through the UI as test-team-member (only login available; Maya, Ravi and Dan are all this one account)

steps.text: Ravi the team member opens the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/board (fresh page load, same session)

steps.text: "Staging is back up" appears with Maya as author and the time it was posted
steps.command: agent-browser snapshot | grep cell
steps.observed: row: 'Staging is back up 1792180792' | author 'test-team-member' | '10/16/2026, 7:59:53 PM'. Author is the shared test account, so distinct-author display was not separable.

scenarios.rule: Everyone on the team sees every note, newest first, with author and time

steps.text: Maya posted "First note of the day" and then Ravi posted "Second note of the day"
steps.command: posted both through the UI in order, 3s apart, as the single test login

steps.text: Dan the team member opens the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/board

steps.text: "Second note of the day" is listed above "First note of the day"
steps.command: agent-browser wait --text "Second note of the day 1792180792" --timeout 5000; agent-browser snapshot | grep cell
steps.observed: Second row at 7:59:58 PM precedes First row at 7:59:55 PM

scenarios.rule: Only a signed-in team member may see or post notes
scenarios.scenario: A visitor who is not signed in

steps.text: a visitor who has not signed in
steps.command: fresh browser session, no credentials

steps.text: the visitor opens the board
steps.command: agent-browser open <base>/; agent-browser get url

steps.text: no notes are shown
steps.command: agent-browser get count "[data-testid=note], li, article"; agent-browser snapshot -i
steps.observed: 0 note elements; page showed only the Sign In form; no /api/notes request in network log

scenarios.rule: Notes cannot be edited or deleted
scenarios.scenario: A posted note has no edit or delete

steps.text: Maya has posted the note "Cake on Friday"
steps.command: note present on board from the earlier run, visible in the table

steps.text: Maya looks at that note on the board
steps.command: agent-browser snapshot -i

steps.text: she has no way to change or remove it
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody button, tbody a, td button"
steps.observed: 0 controls in note rows; interactive snapshot lists only sidebar, theme, account, Post note
